title: drosera latifolia
intro: Drosera latifolia, commonly known as the broad-leaved sundew, is a carnivorous plant species that belongs to the Droseraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Drosera latifolia include expectorant, antitussive, and anti-catarrhal effects, helping to relieve symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include iridoids, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
